title: zone-crossing-inject telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for context-guard's zone lines, sent by its mod (hooks/register.tsx). Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "zone-crossing-inject"; envelope status "ok". The envelope `hook_event` names the mod event that carried the fire: "tool.call" or "prompt.submit" when lines went to Claude, "turn.complete" when an operator-mode suggestion was shown. Emitted only on a fire that sends lines or shows a suggestion; a fire that sends nothing, an improvement included, emits nothing. Records from the settings hook this replaced also carry "PostToolBatch" or "UserPromptSubmit". Evolves additive-only.

zone.description: The session's zone word at the fire: "smart" | "acceptable" | "dumb" | "unknown". Always present on mod records.

previous.description: On a fire that carries a crossing, the zone crossed from, empty string when the session had no earlier observation; otherwise the last recorded zone word, empty string when there is none.

armed.description: The worst zone the session had reached in its current cycle before this fire: "smart" | "acceptable" | "dumb". A zone's line fires when the session first reaches it; only a return to smart re-arms. Absent on records written before the field existed.

injected.description: true when lines went to Claude: a crossing, an approach margin, an operator threshold or a restatement. false only together with suggested: true.

suggested.description: true when operator mode held the lines and showed the continuation menu as the prompt box's suggestion instead. Absent when lines were sent, and on records written before the field existed.

path.description: Deprecated; the mod never writes it. How the retired settings hook reached its decision: "fast" (no resolver ran), "coalesced" (the last zone reused), "resolving" (the resolver ran). Present only on records from that hook; consumers tolerate its absence and values not listed here.
